what: Mind 15 market-state map (charter L2). Leads, not proven edges.

vol.how: volatility: the last hour's average 15m range against its 30-day average (terciles)

trend.how: trend: 4h AND daily trend scores both DOWN (<= -0.5) / both UP (>= +0.5) / anything else

session.how: session by the UTC hour of the bar's close: Asia 22-07, London 07-12, overlap 12-16, New York 16-22; Saturday and Sunday = weekend

flow.how: order flow: net taker buying over the last 4 hours as a share of volume (terciles)

place.how: place: where the close sits in the last 24 hours' high-low range (terciles)

move.how: recent move: the last hour's return in units of the 1-hour ATR14 (terciles)

luck.how_tests_are_counted: cells with >= 30 independent cases in all four tests x 4 outcome measures (f4, f16, tb16, tb96) x 2 sides
luck.note: Cells overlap (a pair contains its singles) and BTC and ETH move together, so the binomial numbers are rough bounds; the placebo (states slid in time, both coins by the same amount) keeps all of that structure and is the number to trust.
